title: Canonical Segment 116 Knowledge Catalog
purpose: Single entry point for source-derived TransArmor Load Data Segment knowledge, applicability, validation boundaries, and training evidence.

systemBoundary.aiSolution: Generates BR, TS, TC, request JSON, and traceability artifacts.
systemBoundary.testSolution: Independently validates AI artifacts against this catalog and ATL105 source evidence.
systemBoundary.sourceOfTruth: ATL105 2026-3 and docs/specs/kb/segment-116-canonical-anchors.md; full field layout requires the external BUYPASS Platform ATL105 Specification Updates for TransArmor Processing document

trainingRule: Do not infer Segment 116's field layout beyond Segment Type and the pattern-derived Segment Length. Obtain the external TransArmor document before certifying any Item beyond a partial Item 1 baseline.
finalCertificationGate: Requires the external TransArmor specification-updates document, an authoritative AI artifact package, approved SME/TBA decisions, passing baseline and mutation tests, and external converter execution.
